content:
VERDICT: REVISE

Source basis: this Orcastrata worktree only. Confirmed: plugin 1.2.0, native `/orcastrata-*` aliases, `/orcastrata-audit` -> `codexmax-verify` (local evidence audit, not PR/issue), hooks SessionStart/SubagentStart with no GitHub, WorkGraph leases/readiness, GoalBuddy boards, loop skill executed:false, native-interface freeze “No AOL integration / no GitHub mutation”, no `/orcastrata-audit-full`. Not in-tree: AOL `src/connectors/github/`, OAuth/device flow, Keychain, inherited credential-source refs, Assurance 1.0.0 consumer. Those AOL claims are planning assertions, not observed source.

BLOCKERS
1. Fresh-implementer gap / wrong plan path. Candidate cites `notes/aol-integration-handoff.md`; actual file is `docs/goals/orcastrata-aol-github-umbrella-v1/notes/aol-integration-handoff.md`. T030 “allowed files” are unnamed AOL connector/credential-source/runtime paths after “fresh impact mapping”. AOL is a dirty external checkout, unpinned. A new implementer in this repo cannot build or test T030. Pin AOL revision, linked worktree, and exact paths in T020 before any code.
2. Credential-blind discovery is not actually blind. Sequence uses `command -v gh` (shell, violates fixed-argv) then `gh auth status` (account/login/scope text) then `git remote get-url origin` (https://user:token@host is common) then `gh repo view`. Missing: absolute executable pin between probe and use; cleaned env that drops GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN/GH_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN/GH_HOST; refuse rather than inherit env tokens; remote URL redaction/normalization; hostname not hardcoded only after operator repo bind. Auth status is not permission. `viewerPermission` is not an AOL action decision.
3. Write/merge operations leak into the T030 surface. “Initial operation set” includes `createIssue` and names `enableAutoMerge`/`mergePullRequest`. A shared adapter enum is how mutation authority ships in a read-only tranche. T030 enum must be closed: probeCapability, readRepository, listIssues, readIssue, readPullRequest, listPullRequestChecks, readPullRequestDiffSummary. No create/update/comment/merge symbols, stubs, or gh subcommands.
4. Unknown-outcome recovery is specified after the effect. Receipts plus a body marker cannot recover a crash between GitHub apply and AOL persist. Require a durable prepare record (intent, idempotency key, repo, op, decision id) before the transport call; then observe; then commit identity. Timeout with no prepare log is not safely retryable. T050 cannot be “implement recovery” if T030/T040 never define the intent log.
5. Idempotency key includes umbrella revision. A preview/docs tweak mints a new key and duplicates issues. Stable key = workspace + child_id + repository + operation kind. Revision belongs in marker payload and receipt, not identity. Reuse algorithm must be: matching AOL receipt first; else search by marker; zero hits + no prepare -> create; one hit -> reuse; many hits -> fail closed. Do not use labels or titles as identity.
6. Dual GitHub clients and dual GoalBuddy. T060 allows Orcastrata “GitHub read operations”; T070 audit-full needs CI/reviews/reconciliation but forbids GitHub effects and does not name an AOL observation API. That forces a second gh/OAuth client inside the plugin or makes audit consume AOL-authored evidence (not independent). Also: this repo already has GoalBuddy/WorkGraph as board/lease truth; plan says AOL Work/GoalBuddy is canonical. T060 WorkGraph writes vs AOL umbrella state are unfenced. One observation record schema owned by AOL; Orcastrata consumes receipts only. Orcastrata must not grow a GitHub transport.
7. `/orcastrata-audit` semantic collision. 1.2.0 native audit is `codexmax-verify` (claims, receipts, tests, Parent acceptance). Redefining it as “one PR vs one issue contract” breaks the frozen native-interface command family and the Assurance 1.0.0 consumer. Do not overload it. A later PR/umbrella gate needs a new name and a versioned consumer. Audit-full also duplicates AOL Assurance policy (CI, reviews, migrations, security, mergeability). Orcastrata audit = evidence completeness; AOL Assurance = admission.
8. GitHub auto-merge vs decision expiry. `enableAutoMerge` can merge after the AOL decision expires, checks flip, or projection revises. Unknown merge outcome plus GitHub-owned completion is not fenced by “don’t retry”. V1 merge is a single explicit `mergePullRequest` under a live unexpired decision; no GitHub auto-merge.

HIGH-VALUE CHANGES
- Bind repository from the T020 authority packet, not from `origin` (forks, credentialed remotes, wrong host).
- One transport result schema (repo, issue, PR, check, diff-summary) independent of gh vs OAuth. Select transport once per effect; persist selection on the prepare record; never switch after prepare.
- Projection vs reconciliation already correct; add: GitHub cannot close/complete GoalBuddy; AOL done-state is not GitHub issue state; no dependency labels as canonical edges.
- Worker packet = existing assignment skill (allowed_files, lease, budgets, forbidden merge/board mutation). Do not invent a parallel “issue worker runtime”. PR babysitting = operator-invoked or existing loop dry-run/match only; no new scheduler.
- Context: hard byte/item caps on worker packet, monitor delta, audit fetch-on-failure. “Measure tokens” is telemetry, not an acceptance gate. Provider token counts are often unknown in this plugin.
- Align oracles: goal.md accepts a first vertical slice; state.yaml final_proof demands PR/audit/merge. Split oracles per milestone or T090 will be used to smuggle the whole program into T030.
- T070 must not depend on T060. A read-only aggregator can exist after receipts exist; babysitting is not a prerequisite for audit independence.
- T030 fake-process matrix is good; add: env-token inheritance denial, embedded-credential remote, swapped binary after probe, hostname mismatch, origin-not-authority, stderr token redaction. Real canary: named public read-only repo, no issue write, skip (not fail the goal) if gh absent — board rule `missing_input_or_credentials_do_not_stop_goal` currently fights T030 stop conditions.

REJECTED COMPLEXITY
- New generic multi-transport framework / operation bus. Extend the existing AOL connector with a gh backend behind the same operations.
- Graph Engineering indexing in V1.
- Scheduled/hourly PR babysitting.
- GitHub auto-merge and hook-triggered merge.
- New OAuth, token copy, or Orcastrata credential registry.
- Rewriting `/orcastrata-audit` / adding `/orcastrata-audit-full` in the first implementation tranche.
- Cross-PR integration engine, migration/doc/security oracles as a separate auditor product.
- Token/economics measurement as a ship gate.
- Atomic AOL+GitHub+Git transactions.
- Atlas/roadmap mutation from this board.

SMALLEST SAFE FIRST TRANCHE
T020 then T030 only, in a clean AOL linked worktree, pinned revision, exact file list. Deliverable: credential-blind probe + structured read of one operator-named repo through fixed argv, cleaned env, absolute `gh`, output caps, redaction, transport-selection receipt that records readiness ≠ authority. Proof: fake-process negatives + one isolated real read-only `gh` canary. Explicitly out: OAuth changes, issue writes, merge symbols, Orcastrata plugin/command changes, umbrella schema, workers, audit-full, schedulers, Graph Engineering. If AOL cannot be pinned, do not grant T030.
